lines.title: Beacon BEHLT Electric Hydraulic Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Beacon's standard electric hydraulic scissor lift tables, rated 1,000 to 12,000 lb, including a 16 in. wide narrow version.
lines.content:
The BEHLT series is Beacon's standard electric hydraulic lift table for manufacturing and assembly work. It has an internal 2 HP motor on 460 V three-phase power, is powered up and gravity down, and uses one to four cylinders depending on the model.

Capacities run from 1,000 to 12,000 lb, with decks from 24 to 72 in. wide and 48 to 144 in. long and raised heights from 43 to 82 in. Electric pinch point protection, an internal velocity fuse, a 24 V push-button control, a maintenance prop and an upper travel limit switch are standard. The BEHLT-N has a narrow 16 x 48 in. platform for 1,000 or 2,000 lb loads.
key_features: Velocity fuse and upper limit switch
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BEHLT-WS Economy Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Economical 1,500 lb work station scissor lift tables with an external power unit and hand control.
lines.content:
The BEHLT-WS Economy Scissor Lift is a compact work station table for raising parts to a comfortable working height in limited space.

All models are rated 1,500 lb, in platform sizes from 24 x 36 to 40 x 48 in. An external power unit and hand control are standard.

lines.title: Beacon BEHLTS and BEHLTSD Compact Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Compact electric hydraulic lift tables for tight spaces, rated 500 to 5,000 lb, with single or double scissor leg sets.
lines.content:
Beacon's compact lift tables are designed for work in tight spaces. The BEHLTS has a single leg set with a 35 in. raised height, and the BEHLTSD uses a double stacked leg set on smaller decks, from 12 x 28 in., for up to 51 in. of raised height.

Capacities run from 500 to 5,000 lb. Both have an internal brass velocity fuse, a perimeter pinch point guard, an external power unit with hand control and 460 V three-phase power as standard, with rotary or reciprocating air/oil power optional.
key_features: Single or double scissor leg sets
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BCDL Small Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: High-speed electro-hydraulic scissor lift tables with an 18 x 36 in. base, rated up to 2,000 lb.
lines.content:
The BCDL Small Scissor Lift is a high-speed electro-hydraulic lift table with an 18 x 36 in. base frame and platforms up to 30 x 60 in. It lowers to 7 in. and raises to 43 in.

Models are rated from 500 to 2,000 lb. Straight toe guards for surface mounting are standard, with tapered toe guards supplied for pit mounting. A 10 ft power cord is included.

lines.title: Beacon BEHLTD Double Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Double scissor lift tables with 60 or 72 in. of travel, rated 1,000 to 5,000 lb.
lines.content:
The BEHLTD Double Scissor Lift raises loads to higher elevations than a single scissor, with 60 or 72 in. of vertical travel and raised heights of 70 or 84 in.

Capacities run from 1,000 to 5,000 lb, with platforms 34 to 48 in. wide and 48 to 88 in. long. Electric toe guards, a brass velocity fuse, a 24 V push-button control, a maintenance prop and an upper travel limit switch are standard.
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BEHLTX Low Profile Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Low profile lift tables from 3-1/4 in. lowered height for pallet jack loading without a pit, rated 1,000 to 3,500 lb.
lines.content:
The BEHLTX Low Scissor Lift lowers to 3-1/4 in., so skids and pallets can be loaded with a pallet jack without a pit. Optional BARX approach ramps suit low pallet jacks.

Capacities run from 1,000 to 3,500 lb, with decks 36 to 60 in. wide and 53 to 60 in. long, all raising to 39 in. A remote power unit, electric toe guards, cylinder velocity fuses and a 24 V hand control are standard.
categories: Lift Tables > Low Profile Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BEHU U-Shaped Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Low-profile U-shaped lift tables loaded directly by pallet truck, in steel and 304 stainless steel versions.
lines.content:
The BEHU Adjustable U Table has an open-center U-shaped platform that lets a pallet truck place a load directly on the table. An external power pack with a dust cover, a pressure relief valve, a flow control valve for lowering and velocity fuses in the cylinders are standard.

Steel models are rated 2,000 or 3,000 lb on 115 V single-phase power, with electric toe guards, a safety prop and an emergency stop. The BEHU-SS is built from 304 stainless steel, apart from its electrical parts and power unit, for sanitary environments and is rated 1,200 lb.
categories: Lift Tables > Low Profile Lift Tables
Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables
Lift Tables > Stainless Steel Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BEHLTG Ground Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Ground entry lift tables that lower to 1/2 in. for pallet truck loading, rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
The BEHLTG Ground Lift Table lowers to 1/2 in. so pallets can be loaded with a pallet truck where no fork truck is available, then raises them to a working height of up to 48 in. Two hydraulic cylinders lift the deck, and a remote enclosed motor can sit up to 8 ft away.

Capacities are 2,000, 4,000 or 6,000 lb, with decks 38 to 72 in. wide. A 2 HP motor, electric pinch point protection, velocity fuses, a foot control, a hinged maintenance prop and an upper travel limit switch are standard, with a galvanized finish and rollover bridges optional.
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BEHLT-TL Long Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Medium-duty double leg set lift tables with 12 or 15 ft long platforms, rated 2,000 or 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
The BEHLT-TL Long Scissor Lift Table uses a double leg set to support a long, stable platform at an economical price. Platforms are 30 or 48 in. wide and 144 or 180 in. long.

Models are rated 2,000 or 4,000 lb, lower to 10 in. and raise to 46 or 58 in. They have electric toe guards for surface or pit mounting and a remote electric hydraulic power unit and control box in a plastic cover, on 460 V three-phase power.

lines.title: Beacon BHLTTL Tandem Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Heavy-duty tandem scissor lift tables with platforms up to 18 ft long, rated 2,000 to 12,000 lb.
lines.content:
The BHLTTL series uses a tandem, double-long scissor leg set to lift long work loads to a comfortable working height. Standard platforms run from 24 x 96 to 24 x 168 in., with maximum platforms up to 48 x 216 in.

Capacities run from 2,000 to 12,000 lb, with 36 or 48 in. of travel. Straight toe guards for surface mounting are standard, with bevelled toe guards supplied for pit mounting.
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BMLT Heavy Duty Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: High-capacity electro-hydraulic scissor lift tables rated 15,000 to 120,000 lb, in single, double long, double wide and quad designs.
lines.content:
Beacon's BMLT series covers its heaviest scissor lift tables. The standard BMLT is rated 15,000 to 30,000 lb, the double long BMLTDL and double wide BMLTDW 25,000 to 60,000 lb, and the four-scissor BMLTQD 50,000 to 120,000 lb.

Lowered heights are 16 or 20 in., with raised heights from 46 to 92 in. and platforms up to 120 x 264 in. Dual safety restraint maintenance bars and straight toe guards for surface mounting are standard, with bevelled toe guards supplied for pit mounting and air/oil power optional.
key_features: Single, double long, double wide and quad designs
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon High Travel Scissor Lifts
lines.excerpt: Double, triple and quadruple scissor lifts with 60 to 288 in. of travel for mezzanines and high elevations.
lines.content:
Beacon's high travel lifts stack scissor leg sets for tall lifts on compact platforms. The double BDSL gives 60 to 144 in. of travel, the triple BTSL 72 to 180 in. and the quadruple BQSL 240 or 288 in., and the BZ-BDSL is a mobile double scissor lift on casters with outriggers and locking ears for transfers.

Capacities run from 2,000 to 6,000 lb on the BDSL and 3,000 or 6,000 lb on the BTSL and BQSL. They use high-pressure gear pumps with a flow limiter at each cylinder, mechanical upper travel stops and safety maintenance bars. The BCLTPB is a stacked dual scissor lift rated from 1,000 lb with an 89 in. raised height.
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BUNI Lift and Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Compact lift and tilt tables that tilt containers up to 40 degrees toward the operator, rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
The BUNI Lift and Tilt Table places containers within easy reach of machine operators and assembly workers. A selector pedal lets the user lift and tilt together, or tilt and then lift, and the platform has a 12 in. lip on the tilt side.

Capacities are 2,000, 4,000 or 6,000 lb, with platforms from 24 x 48 to 96 x 48 in., which holds two 48 in. containers. A 2 HP motor, flow control valve, maintenance lock and adjustable travel switch are standard. The BUNI-P portable version is moved by fork truck and rated 4,000 lb.
key_features: Lift and tilt together or in sequence

lines.title: Beacon BEHLTT Lift and Tilt Scissor Tables
lines.excerpt: Scissor lift tables with a tilting deck that raise loads to 49 in. and tilt them 45 to 90 degrees, rated 1,000 to 5,000 lb.
lines.content:
The BEHLTT Lift Tilt Table raises work to a comfortable height and then tilts it toward the worker, controlled by push buttons. A 12 in. lip and a restraining chain hold the load during tilting.

Capacities run from 1,000 to 5,000 lb, with 36 or 48 in. deck widths, raised heights up to 49 in. and tilt of 45 to 90 degrees. Electric toe guards are standard, and options include skirting, air/oil power, foot controls, wireless remote control and washdown packages.

lines.title: Beacon BZLTT Ground Lift and Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Ground entry lift and tilt tables that lower to 1/2 in. for pallet truck loading and tilt to 45 degrees, rated 2,000 or 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
The BZLTT Ground Lift and Tilt lowers to 1/2 in. so loads can be placed with a standard hand pallet truck, with no pit, then raises and tilts them up to 45 degrees.

Models are rated 2,000 or 4,000 lb, with platforms from 44 x 52 to 52 x 72 in. and raised heights of 36 or 48 in. Electric pinch point guards, steel shrouds, a vinyl flap on the entry side, upper limit switches for lift and tilt and brass velocity fuses are standard.
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BHTT Hydraulic Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Heavy-duty electric hydraulic tilt tables with 45 or 90 degrees of tilt, rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb, with decks up to 120 x 120 in.
lines.content:
The BHTT Hydraulic Tilt Table is a heavy-duty work station tilter with decks up to 120 x 120 in. It is powered by an internal motor, pump and reservoir from 3/4 to 1-1/2 HP, and an adjustable limit switch sets the tilt angle.

Capacities run up to 6,000 lb. 45-degree models use single-acting cylinders with internal stops, and models that tilt to 90 degrees use double-acting cylinders. Straight safety toe guards and lifetime-lubricated bearings are standard.
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BEHTT Tilt Platforms
lines.excerpt: Low 4,000 lb hydraulic tilt platforms with 45 degrees of tilt, in hinge and sliding link designs.
lines.content:
The BEHTT Tilt Platform tilts materials to a comfortable working angle from a low platform height. A 12 in. lip without side gussets lets it be loaded from three sides.

It is rated 4,000 lb on a 48 x 48 in. platform, with a maximum tilt of 45 degrees. The hinge model has a 10 in. level height and the sliding link model, which keeps the load close to the frame's center, an 8 in. level height. A 2 HP motor and 24 V pendant control are standard.

lines.title: Beacon BGLT Ground Tilters
lines.excerpt: Floor-level hydraulic tilters loaded by pallet truck, rated 4,000 lb with 45 degrees of tilt.
lines.content:
The BGLT-4000 Ground Tilter is a low-profile parts tilter that sits on the floor so it can be loaded and unloaded with a pallet jack. Pinch point protection is provided on all four sides.

It is rated 4,000 lb on a 48 x 50 in. platform, tilting to 45 degrees. A remote 2 HP power unit with a protective cover and a standard hand control operate it, with a foot control optional.
key_features: Pinch point protection on four sides
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BEM1 Industrial Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Pallet and container tilters with 45 or 90 degrees of tilt and a 12 or 24 in. lip, rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
The BEM1 Industrial Tilt Table tilts crates, pallets, baskets and boxes for easier loading and unloading. BEM1-200 models tilt 45 degrees with a 12 in. lip, and BEM1-500 models tilt 90 degrees with a 24 in. lip and must be lagged to the floor.

Capacities are 2,000, 4,000 or 6,000 lb, with platforms from 42 x 50 to 60 x 50 in. All-welded steel construction, a 2 HP motor and a 24 V push-button hand control are standard.

lines.title: Beacon BEMC Corner Tilters
lines.excerpt: Hydraulic corner tilters that tip crates, boxes and baskets 30 degrees, rated 2,000 or 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
The BEMC Corner Tilting unit tips crates, boxes and baskets 30 degrees onto a corner so their contents are easier to reach. Built-in fork tubes let it be moved by fork truck.

Models are rated 2,000 or 4,000 lb, on 42 x 42 or 48 x 48 in. platforms with 24 in. sides. A 2 HP AC motor and a water-resistant push-button control are standard.

lines.title: Beacon BBTT Bench Top Tilters
lines.excerpt: Manual and linear actuated tilters that mount on work benches and lift tables, rated 500 to 1,000 lb with up to 45 degrees of tilt.
lines.content:
BBTT Bench Top Tilters attach to work benches, table tops and mobile lift tables. A sliding top tilts within the frame, keeping the load centered over the base for more stability than a hinge-style tilter, and a 3 in. lip retains the load.

Manual models are rated 600 lb and set to 15, 30 or 45 degrees with a rod when unloaded. Linear actuated models run from a standard 110 V outlet, adjust anywhere from 0 to 45 degrees with a pendant control and are rated 500 or 1,000 lb.
key_features: Mounts on benches and lift tables

lines.title: Beacon Foot Pump Scissor Lift Carts
lines.excerpt: Hydraulic scissor lift carts raised by foot or hand pump, rated 220 to 4,000 lb, in steel, stainless and aluminum versions.
lines.content:
Beacon's hydraulic lift carts move loads between work stations and raise them to a working height. The BCART Hydraulic Lift Cart comes in steel, stainless steel and aluminum versions from 220 to 4,000 lb, the BCART-S-FR in single and double scissor versions from 300 to 1,000 lb, and the BSCTAB Mobile Elevating Table from 400 to 2,500 lb with torsion tubes for side-to-side stability.

Carts use a foot or hand pump with a soft-lowering valve, and each cylinder has an internal velocity fuse. BSCTAB tables are also offered with AC or DC power lifts, and power lift, battery and traction drive options are available on the BCART series.

lines.title: Beacon BCART-LP Low Profile Lift Cart
lines.excerpt: A 900 lb foot pump scissor lift cart that lowers to 3-1/2 in. and raises to 24 in.
lines.content:
The BCART-900-LP Low Scissor Lift Cart lowers to 3-1/2 in. and raises to 24 in. Its two-speed manual hydraulic foot pump doubles the lifting speed when the pedal is turned to the left.

It is rated 900 lb on a 23-3/4 x 35-5/8 in. platform, with heavy-duty steel construction, a speed control valve for controlled lowering and a built-in load check valve.
categories: Lift Tables > Low Profile Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BCART-PN Pneumatic Tire Lift Carts
lines.excerpt: Hydraulic scissor lift carts on oversized air tires for rough surfaces, rated 400 to 1,500 lb.
lines.content:
BCART-PN lift carts have oversized front and rear air tires for moving loads over rough or uneven surfaces. They are welded steel with a powder coat finish, and a hydraulic system with a soft-lowering valve raises and lowers the platform.

Capacities run from 400 to 1,500 lb, with platforms from 20-1/2 x 27-1/2 to 24 x 48 in. and raised heights up to 67 in.

lines.title: Beacon DC Powered Scissor Lift Carts
lines.excerpt: Battery-powered push-around scissor lift carts rated 1,000 to 1,500 lb, with an onboard charger.
lines.content:
Beacon's DC powered lift carts raise and lower at the push of a button, powered by a 12 V battery with an onboard 115 V charger. The BCART-DC Mobile Scissor Lift has a key switch, a coil cord hand control and a perimeter pinch-point guard, and is also offered with a two-speed foot pump.

BCART-DC carts are rated 1,000 or 1,500 lb, on 24 x 36 or 24 x 48 in. platforms. BCART-SCTAB carts are listed at 1,000 lb with single or double scissors and raised heights up to 63-3/4 in. Each cylinder has an internal velocity fuse.
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BCART-DC-CTD Powered Drive Lift Carts
lines.excerpt: Scissor lift carts with 24 V powered lift and drive, rated 1,000 or 1,500 lb, with a twist throttle up to 3.7 mph.
lines.content:
The BCART-DC-CTD Powered Lift Cart combines a 24 V DC scissor lift with a powered drive, so workers don't have to push heavy loads. A twist throttle gives variable speed from 0 to 3.7 mph in forward and reverse.

Models are rated 1,000 lb with a single scissor or 1,500 lb with a double scissor, raising to 40 or 66-1/2 in. Two 12 V batteries, a charger, an emergency reverse, a horn, automatic braking and a key switch are standard.
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BPST Portable Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Heavy-duty battery-powered mobile lift tables rated 1,000 to 5,000 lb, with raised heights of 46 to 60 in.
lines.content:
The BPST Portable Lift Table is a heavy-duty mobile lift for raising and moving heavy loads in warehouses and plants. A 12 V DC battery with an onboard charger and charge indicator powers the lift, with push buttons on the power unit and a pendant on an 8 ft coil cord.

Capacities run from 1,000 to 5,000 lb, with platforms 24 to 48 in. wide and 48 to 90 in. long and raised heights of 46 to 60 in. A safety stop, 8 in. phenolic casters, a push rail and electric toe guards are standard, with AC, air/oil, foot pump and power traction drive options.
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BCART-LA Linear Actuated Lift Carts
lines.excerpt: Battery-powered scissor carts raised by an electric linear actuator that does not drift, rated 400 to 500 lb.
lines.content:
BCART-LA Elevating Portable Carts are raised and lowered by an electric linear actuator for precise positioning, and the platform does not drift down as hydraulic carts can. The hand control has an emergency stop button.

Models are rated 400 or 500 lb, with a 15 in. lowered height and raised heights of 33 to 50 in. BCART-400 models have two 12 V AGM batteries with a bench top charger, and the BCART-500-LA a lithium battery with an onboard charger.
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon BCART-M Mechanical Lift Carts
lines.excerpt: A 660 lb hand-crank screw scissor lift cart with no downward drift.
lines.content:
The BCART-660-M Manual Lift Cart is a screw lift cart raised and lowered with a hand crank, so the platform holds its position with no downward drift.

It is rated 660 lb on a 23-1/2 x 37 in. platform, with a 17-1/4 in. lowered height and 39-1/4 in. raised height. Four poly-on-poly wheels, with brakes on the rear swivel pair, are standard.

lines.title: Beacon Stainless Steel Lift Carts
lines.excerpt: Full and partially stainless steel scissor lift carts for washdown, food and pharmaceutical work, rated 200 to 2,000 lb.
lines.content:
Beacon offers several scissor lift carts for corrosive, wet and clean environments. The BSSSC is built entirely from 304 stainless steel, including its foot pump, and is rated 200 to 1,000 lb for washdown use in pharmaceutical, medical and food plants.

The partially stainless BCART-PSS carts have stainless platforms, frames, handles and hardware with zinc-plated scissor legs and pumps, and are rated from 220 lb. The range also includes a hand-crank mechanical cart (BCART-660-M-PSS) and a linear actuated cart with a lithium battery (BCART-500-LA-PSS).
key_features: Foot pump, hand crank or linear actuator
categories: Lift Tables > Stainless Steel Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon Self-Elevating Spring Carts and Tables
lines.excerpt: Spring-powered carts and tables that rise as the load is removed, keeping work at a steady height, rated 230 to 2,000 lb.
lines.content:
Beacon's self-elevating carts and tables use springs to raise or lower the platform as material is added or removed, keeping the top of the load at a comfortable working height without power.

BSCSC scissor carts are rated 400 to 2,000 lb, with adjustable tension springs and removable casters on the self-adjusting models so they can be used as stationary tables. BETS self-elevating tables are rated 230 to 1,120 lb, with removable counter-balance springs to tune their sensitivity.
key_features: Rises as the load is removed

lines.title: Beacon BSST Spring Scissor Lift
lines.excerpt: A partially stainless steel spring pallet positioner with a 360-degree rotating top, for loads of 400 to 4,500 lb.
lines.content:
The BSST Spring Scissor Lift is a self-levelling pallet positioner for shipping and distribution work. Its internal springs raise the load as it is unloaded and lower it as it is built, keeping it at a comfortable height.

It handles uniform loads from 400 to 4,500 lb, with a service range of 9 to 27-3/4 in. The 43-5/8 in. round top rotates 360 degrees by hand, with an open ring (BSST-45-PSS) or solid top (BSST-45-PSS-ST). The base, springs and legs are partially stainless steel.
categories: Lift Tables > Stainless Steel Lift Tables

lines.title: Beacon Pneumatic Scissor Lifts
lines.excerpt: Air-powered scissor lift tables and lift carts for clean rooms and areas without electricity, rated 200 to 2,000 lb.
lines.content:
Beacon's pneumatic lifts run on factory air instead of electricity or an electric hydraulic pump, which suits clean rooms and areas without power. The BABLT Air Lift Table is a low-profile steel table rated 1,000 or 2,000 lb with a push-button control, and the BAT-10 is a 200 lb pneumatic work table.

The BAIR Air Scissor Lift is a mobile cart rated 800 to 2,000 lb that raises either with a manual foot pump for small adjustments or with factory air over oil, in steel or partially stainless steel.
